title.en: FORMAT EXAMPLE — headline as you would write it
title.zh: 格式示例——像这样写标题

summary.en: One or two short sentences with **bold** key terms and ==the core takeaway highlighted==.
summary.zh: 一两句简短的中文，**加粗**关键词，并==突出核心结论==。

key_points.en: Point two: !!risks or contested claims!! in red
key_points.zh: 要点二：用红色标出!!风险或有争议的说法!!
要点三：用绿色标出++已确认的进展++

findings.en: Lists stay lists, even with one entry.
findings.zh: 列表字段即使只有一条也要写成列表。

limitations.en: What the source can't tell us.
limitations.zh: 这个来源无法说明的地方。

evidence_note.en: Say if a claim is only from the company itself or a single report.
evidence_note.zh: 如果说法只来自公司本身或单一报道，要写明。

thesis_relevance.en: Why this matters for this column.
thesis_relevance.zh: 这一条为什么和这个专栏有关。

research_ideas.en: What the reader could do with it.
